name: UCO Bank
title: UCO Bank - 532505 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Strong FY26 beat on credit growth (19.44% vs 12-15% guide) and asset quality (GNPA 2.17%, credit cost 0.62%), but FY27 guidance held at 12-14% and CD ratio rising toward 80-82%, so the supply-side read is pricing discipline on corporate loans, not capacity expansion.

triggers.label: Corporate pipeline held back on pricing
triggers.quote: We do not want credit growth in the Corporate segment at the cost of margins.

triggers.label: Credit growth guide held at 12-14%
triggers.quote: guidance continues in the same range, looking at all scenarios

triggers.label: Standard-asset buffer ~Rs1,900 crore
triggers.quote: So, Rs.1900 crore of buffer is there.

guidance.quote: deposits we have kept the guidance in the same range, 10 to 12%
RAM we have improved our guidance to 62 to 65 %
NIM global in the range of 2.8 to 2.9%
recovery and upgradation in the range of Rs.2,000 to 2,500 crore

prior_guidance_check.quote: deposit growth guidance was 10 to 12%, achievement is 11.59%
credit growth guidance was 12 to 15%, and our actual achievement is 19.44%
RAM percentage we targeted 61 to 63%, actual is 65%
we have achieved a CD ratio of 80.21%
Credit cost guidance was less than 1%, it is 0.62%

red_flags.label: Credit growth 19.44% vs 12-14% FY27 guide
red_flags.quote: guidance continues in the same range, looking at all scenarios

red_flags.label: Treasury loss in Q4; AFS reserves negative
red_flags.quote: AFS reserves, give me a second. It's -140 crore. (Negative) 140 crores.

red_flags.label: Salary cost fell to Rs182 crore from Rs278 crore
red_flags.quote: the salary i.e. the employee cost has gone down to 182 crore as compared to 278 crore in the last quarter

evasions.topic: Salary cost decline / Labour Code impact
evasions.quote: We asked PLI to scale 4 above for the employees, which could not be paid this year because of certain reasons.
